messages:
leah: quick check — i'm about to land an infra PR that converts the inference service from Deployment -> StatefulSet so the kv-cache sidecar can rely on stable pod hostnames. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/482 :eyes:

alex: do we need a statefulset for this? HPA and pod churn concerns if we lock ordinals

leah: yes, sidecar stores per-pod prefix files and expects stable ordinals. plan: start with replicas=3 -> scale to 5, disable HPA initially, do partitioned rolling update for a small canary.

maria: partitioned rolling update? can you paste the k8s snippet?

leah: sure — current plan in the manifest:
```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
spec:
  replicas: 5
  updateStrategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      partition: 2
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: inference
        readinessProbe:
          initialDelaySeconds: 30
          periodSeconds: 10
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 45
```

maria: partition: 2 means pods 0..1 won't be updated? that's intentional?

leah: yep. we want the last 3 pods to be the canary group. once smoke passes we'll advance partition to 0 gradually.

tj: terraform side — i saw the plan wants to replace the Service selector to `app.k8s.redwood/inference`. that would recreate the service and could change nodePort. did you intend to alter selectors?

leah: good catch — i renamed the label key to be more explicit. plan shows service recreation. i added a `lifecycle { ignore_changes = [\"spec.ports[0].nodePort\"] }` to avoid accidental nodePort churn. also kept externalTrafficPolicy: Local.

ryan: recreate svc is acceptable if we do it during maintenance window. also double-check healthcheck path for lb.

sam: sidecar reads secrets from KMS path `projects/infra/secrets/inference/kv`. are we rotating keys or changing bindings in this PR? we need IAM binding so the workload SA can decrypt.

leah: added a small TF resource for KMS binding:
```hcl
resource "google_kms_crypto_key_iam_binding" "inference" {
  crypto_key_id = var.kms_key
  role          = "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter"
  members       = ["serviceAccount:${var.inference_sa}"]
}
```

infra-bot: terraform plan finished for infra/ks-inference — to add: 5, to change: 2, to destroy: 1

maria: LGTMs from me, but can you ping oncall for a window? @alex

alex: oncall ok for tonight 23:00 UTC. keep rollout as canary then full.

leah: will queue PR and include manual rollback steps: 1) scale statefulset to previous replica count, 2) set partition back to replicas, 3) restore old service selector if needed. i'll also add an alert runbook for cache-miss rates and 95th latency.

tj: tiny ask — bump readiness initialDelaySeconds to 30 (slow model init) and add a preStop hook to flush cache before SIGTERM.

leah: done in the manifest, added preStop:
```yaml
lifecycle:
  preStop:
    exec:
      command: ["/bin/sh", "-c", "curl -sS http://localhost:8080/flush-cache || true; sleep 2"]
```

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled for 2026-03-18T23:00:00Z (canary) by @leah

sam: :thumbsup:

leah: thanks all — i will watch the canary and post status in #incidents if anything spikes.
